name: Enzalutamide (mCRPC)

biomarkers.note: Enzalutamide is an androgen-receptor inhibitor and is not biomarker-restricted. Castrate testosterone (below 50 ng/dL) must be maintained with ongoing ADT. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Prostate Cancer, Systemic Therapy for M1 CRPC (PROS-18) and PROS-G.

lineOfTherapy: androgen-receptor inhibitor option for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer; category 1 in the pre-taxane (pre-docetaxel) setting when no prior ARPI has been given

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (M1 CRPC) with castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL maintained on ADT
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, PROS-18 (systemic therapy for M1 CRPC, Enzalutamide category 1), prostate line 1780; PROS-G, prostate line 3003 (castrate testosterone maintained)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: ongoing ADT (orchiectomy, LHRH agonist, or LHRH antagonist)

drugs.name: Enzalutamide

provenance.locator: Discussion, prostate line 7290 (enzalutamide 160 mg daily, phase 3 randomized trial); prostate lines 6880 and 6467 (enzalutamide 160 mg/day)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion (prostate lines 7290, 6880, 6467). Enzalutamide 160 mg PO once daily continuously. No companion steroid required (unlike abiraterone).

supportiveCare: continue ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL (PROS-G).
cycles null: continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
no companion corticosteroid is required with enzalutamide.

monitoring: PSA and serum testosterone (confirm castrate level)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 or higher toxicity or seizure
doseModificationRules.text: Hold enzalutamide per labeling; on recovery resume at a reduced dose; discontinue if a seizure occurs; obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: enzalutamide (androgen-receptor inhibitor) improves survival in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (AFFIRM/PREVAIL)

guideline.locator: PROS-18 (systemic therapy for M1 CRPC, Enzalutamide category 1), prostate line 1780; Discussion (enzalutamide 160 mg daily), prostate lines 7290, 6880, 6467

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for enzalutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (disease #54 mCRPC). The enzalutamide dose (160 mg PO once daily) is dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion (prostate lines 7290, 6880, 6467). No companion steroid is required. Ongoing ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL is required (PROS-G). cycleLengthDays 28 with cycles null (continuous until progression). No dose was invented or inferred. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
